 .;Entry point to display data
 .;
 .;HDR^DGJTEE - set tab display texts
 .;DGJTVIEW - Display control (0=edit, 1=view only)
 .;DIC - FileMan global root for HL7 Message File (#773) (also HL7 ien)
 .;EN^DGJTVW1 - Build display
 .
323e192c: Get date/time in external form, dereference message file
e9c9ea66: Set coded by label and asterisk if viewing
ba38e5dc: Set coded by into display array
c77429c2: Lookup coded by VA user

439d5ef7: Build data for and resolve data pointers
 .

9c2affe0: 
 .;Determine and set status for HL7 message
 .
01b13327: If incomplete, set status to INCOMPLETE
28c41a9c: If reviewed, set status to REVIEWED
7ae4891c: If signing provider and unsigned, set status to SIGNED NO REVIEW
478a407c: If signing provider and signed, set status to SIGNED
fa5f6172: If incomplete, set status to INCOMPLETE
e6d6bb86: If dictated, set status to DICTATED
5729faec: If transcribed, set status to TRANSCRIBED
b8a32b27: If unsigned, set status to SIGNED NO REVIEW
ed1cd8d5: If signed and not reviewed, set status to SIGNED
39656c88: If reviewed, set status to REVIEWED
